topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, isn’t this just perfect. A surprise party, they said. It was going to be something special, they said. Now, look at this mess. It’s cancelled. Just like that. All that effort, all those plans, flushed down the drain. I don’t need their pity or their half-hearted apologies. Save it. I get enough of that nonsense from people trying to sugarcoat their failures. You think I don’t see through it? I see exactly what this is: another letdown, another excuse. They should have known better. But no, instead of a celebration, I get this sham of a consolation. What a joke.
